views.name: Step 1
views.caption: Unplug the USB cable from the controller's Nano Board.

views.name: Step 1c
views.caption: Unplug the USB cable from the controller's Nano Board.

views.name: Step 2
views.caption: Pull the right joystick back out of R-JS, then lift it out of its pocket.

views.name: Step 2c
views.caption: Pull the right joystick back out of R-JS, then lift it out of its pocket.

views.name: Step 3
views.caption: Pull the left joystick back out of L-JS, then lift it out of its pocket.

views.name: Step 3c
views.caption: Pull the left joystick back out of L-JS, then lift it out of its pocket.

views.name: Step 4
views.caption: Lift the radio module out of its socket.

views.name: Step 4c
views.caption: Lift the radio module out of its socket.

views.name: Step 5
views.caption: Lift the Nano Board out of H1 and H2.

views.name: Step 5c
views.caption: Lift the Nano Board out of H1 and H2.

views.name: Step 6
views.caption: Unplug the 9V adapter's barrel plug from the power socket on the I/O module.

views.name: Step 6c
views.caption: Unplug the 9V adapter's barrel plug from the power socket on the I/O module.

views.name: Step 7
views.caption: Lift the 9V battery, with its 9V adapter, out of the square hole in L1.

views.name: Step 7c
views.caption: Lift the 9V battery, with its 9V adapter, out of the square hole in L1.

views.name: Step 8
views.caption: Unsnap the 9V adapter from the top of the battery.

views.name: Step 8c
views.caption: Unsnap the 9V adapter from the top of the battery.

views.name: Step 9
views.caption: Unplug the right wheel motor from RWh.

views.name: Step 9c
views.caption: Unplug the right wheel motor from RWh.

views.name: Step 10
views.caption: Unplug the left wheel motor from LWh.

views.name: Step 10c
views.caption: Unplug the left wheel motor from LWh.

views.name: Step 11
views.caption: Turn the car over. Slide L6 out.

views.name: Step 11c
views.caption: Turn the car over. Slide L6 out.

views.name: Step 12
views.caption: Slide L7 out.

views.name: Step 12c
views.caption: Slide L7 out.

views.name: Step 13
views.caption: Turn the car the right way up. Slide the I/O module forward, out of the grooves in L4 and L5.

views.name: Step 13c
views.caption: Turn the car the right way up. Slide the I/O module forward, out of the grooves in L4 and L5.

views.name: Step 14
views.caption: Lift the radio module out of U3 on the adapter board.

views.name: Step 14c
views.caption: Lift the radio module out of U3 on the adapter board.

views.name: Step 15
views.caption: Lift the adapter board off the pins along the side of the I/O module.

views.name: Step 15c
views.caption: Lift the adapter board off the pins along the side of the I/O module.

views.name: Step 16
views.caption: Lift the Nano Board out of the I/O module.

views.name: Step 16c
views.caption: Lift the Nano Board out of the I/O module.

views.name: Step 17
views.caption: Lift L4 and L5, with the wheel motors, off L1, bringing each motor's wire up out of its notch.

views.name: Step 17c
views.caption: Lift L4 and L5, with the wheel motors, off L1, bringing each motor's wire up out of its notch.

views.name: Step 18
views.caption: Slide L4 back off along the motors' wires, each plug passing back through its hole in L4.

views.name: Step 18c
views.caption: Slide L4 back off along the motors' wires, each plug passing back through its hole in L4.

views.name: Step 19
views.caption: Pull the left wheel motor out of L5.

views.name: Step 19c
views.caption: Pull the left wheel motor out of L5.

views.name: Step 20
views.caption: Pull the right wheel motor out of L5.

views.name: Step 20c
views.caption: Pull the right wheel motor out of L5.

views.name: Step 21
views.caption: Turn L1 over. Pull L3 off L2 and out of the short slots in L1.

views.name: Step 21c
views.caption: Turn L1 over. Pull L3 off L2 and out of the short slots in L1.

views.name: Step 22
views.caption: Swing L2 up out of its slots in L1, then unhook it from the notch at the flat end of L1.

views.name: Step 22c
views.caption: Swing L2 up out of its slots in L1, then unhook it from the notch at the flat end of L1.
